text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with 
Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Wanna go somewhere 
terrifying with me right now?"
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Actually, a little while back—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, go! Right there! Overtake the 
front—hey, why aren't you going?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Aargh... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Damn it...! It was such 
an important mock race, and I still 
lost... If only I hadn't been afraid to 
dive in at the end...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for regret. You learned 
why you hesitated. You could say you have 
grown one step further.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By knowing our own fears, we can become 
even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Reflect upon yourself. Confront your 
fears, and glory will surely await beyond 
them. I know you can overcome this. I'm 
rooting for you."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
President...! Thank you so much! I'll do 
my best!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rudolf. What you said earlier... 
about becoming stronger once you know 
fear, what did that mean?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah... No, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid that's not something I can 
teach you. Your fear is known only to you, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So with that said— Please! Help me out!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I want to know what fear is and become 
stronger!!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'll lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—This is the haunted spot everyone's been 
talking about lately!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was a pain getting the location 
out of them. Everyone was too chickened 
out, thinking they'd get cursed if they 
spilled.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If I recall the rumor correctly... the 
bell at this shrine rings on its own. 
That's the signal—an old woman appears 
under the eaves. And whoever catches sight 
of her has their soul taken, or so they 
say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang... Clang...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What kind of sound was that?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Trainer, are you scared? For real?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what was scary about it?! How was it 
scary? Tell me all about it!
choice_data_list: The bell's ringing on its own...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The bell? ...But that bell is hanging so 
loosely, looks like even a breeze could 
ring it.
choice_data_list:
The rumor says whenever a bell rings, an 
old woman appears...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. ...Wait, there's no old lady 
here, right? ...Then what's so scary...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My bad, I don't really get it! 
Let's just head to the next spot!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
This is the haunted spot rumored to be the 
scariest of all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...While walking up the stairs, a 
lukewarm breeze blows from behind. The 
moment you turn around— a blood-soaked 
woman pushes you off the tower!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoooooo...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around as suggested, I notice an 
air conditioning fan. If the draft came 
from there, then maybe this isn't a 
paranormal phenomenon after all...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Were you scared of that gust of wind just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, scary in what way? Like, you imagined 
a woman covered in blood?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Why's that? You were scared just a 
minute ago!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that Katsuragi Ace's 
level-headed comments were blowing all the 
fear away.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What did you say!? I just asked a simple 
question... !?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just want to know what my own fear 
is!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I want to learn and get stronger, you 
know!!
choice_data_list: Let's try a different kind of fear.
Maybe it's better not to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"A different kind, huh... Right. 
Apparently, fear comes in many forms."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Clowns, numbers, steamed buns... Guess 
I'll just try them all one by one!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Just you wait, fear! I'm 
definitely gonna feel you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began her journey to learn about 
fear.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Not thinking is abandoning thought 
altogether. In other words, it's the exact 
same as running away!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The only place I'll ever run away is out 
on the turf. Everywhere else, I refuse to 
back down!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna charge right at my fear! I 
won't give up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, her journey to learn what fear 
truly is had begun.
